name: East African Cables Plc
source: East African Cables Plc audited results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2024 (NSE filing, audited by KPMG, audit report dated 25 April 2025). KShs thousands as filed, stored in KES. Operating Expenses is the sum of factory, administrative and selling and distribution expenses plus depreciation and amortisation and the net impairment charge, so gross profit plus other income less operating expenses equals Results from Operating Activities. Income Tax is the tax credit for the year. | CRON 20261013: H1 2025 column added from the East African Cables Plc interim financial statement summary for the six months ended 30 June 2025 (issuer interim filing, as carried by AfricanFinancials HY2025, cross-checked against The Online Kenyan half year report): revenue 1,231,614,000, net loss 190,151,000, loss per share 0.53. Cost of sales, gross profit, profit before tax and income tax are left empty: the interim summary does not print the split, and the company is under administration so the period carries no audited comparatives.
source_note: Gap fill 2026-10-13: Profit Before Tax, Net Profit and EPS read from the East African Cables 2024 annual report and abridged results (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-cabl-2024-ar-00/): loss before tax 536,429 thousand, loss after tax 358,762 thousand, basic and diluted EPS -0.98. The income tax figure is the difference between the two printed losses, a credit of 177,667 thousand, and is tagged derived. Note that the stored shares outstanding of 253,130,000 does not divide into the printed loss after tax to give the printed EPS, which implies the share count carried on the file is stale; the EPS stored here is the issuers own printed figure and was not recomputed. | earlier note: Figures read from the consolidated statement of profit or loss in the audited 2024 results announcement.
